newsitem.title: FRANCE: Elf says merger desirable for Sanofi.
newsitem.headline: Elf says merger desirable for Sanofi.

text.p: French oil company Elf Acquitaine said on Thursday that it would be desirable for its pharmaceutical unit Sanofi to merge with other pharmaceutical laboratories to boost its profitability.
In a statement, it said, "It would be desirable for Sanofi to move nearer other pharmaceutical laboratories, through a merger, in order to speed up its development and increase its profitability."
In this case, Elf Aquitaine "will remain an important shareholder for Sanofi but will not make its present majority ownership a prerequisite," it said.
Elf said that the decision to seek a merger was taken at a meeting of its board on Wednesday at which it discussed the group's long trem development plans..

Just last month, Elf Aquitaine ruled out a merger for Sanofi, such as an often rumoured link with Rhone-Drug Poulenc drug unit Rhone-Poulenc Rorer, saying it wanted to grow the subsidiary through alliances.
A merger would be the latest move in a wave of consolidation of the pharmaceuticals industry worldwide.
Earlier this month, German chemicals giant Hoechst which holds 56.53 percent of French pharmaceuticals group Roussel Uclaf announced an 18.1 billion franc offer to buy out minority shareholders.
